title: Reason for Lower-than-projected Health Ministry Operating Expenditure in FY2025
what_it_is: Reason for Lower-than-projected Health Ministry Operating Expenditure in FY2025

sections.label: MOH FY2025 operating expenditure reduction
sections.summary: MOH's revised FY2025 operating expenditure fell $0.31 billion due to lower-than-expected public healthcare cluster operating cost increases, while spending still rises to $20.04 billion in FY2026.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
sentences.text: asked the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (a) what specific factors led to the $0.31 billion projected reduction in the Ministry’s revised FY2025 operating expenditure compared to the initial estimates; and (b) how does the Ministry reconcile lower-than-projected funding needs for public healthcare institutions with the increased care demands of a rapidly ageing population.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: It is mainly due to lower-than-expected increases in operating costs at the public healthcare clusters and is within an accepted margin of budget variance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Overall, MOH's operating expenditure maintains an upward trajectory.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The revised FY2025 estimate of $18.49 billion is $1.63 billion, or 9.7%, higher than the actual FY2025 operating expenditure.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The trend of increase will continue, as shown by the estimated FY2026 operating expenditure of $20.04 billion.

sections.label: Non-public information on operations
sections.summary: Some information is non-public and related to projects and decisions, but patient care was not compromised and services continued to be delivered well.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Some of the information are non-public information with regard to the operations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But Member can be assured that it was not an issue of compromising of care to patients.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Largely, it related to the different projects and different decisions that were made on certain items, but healthcare services continued to be priority and continued to be delivered well to the patients.
